contact: EBRPD Reservations, (888) 327-2757 option 2, Monday-Friday 9am-4pm Pacific, closed weekends and holidays. Also in person, walk-in, at District HQ, 2950 Peralta Oaks Ct., Oakland. For hearing impairments use the Telecommunications Relay Service at 711; callers in Canada use 510-544-2707.
not_accepted: reservations@ebparks.org is published as the reservations email address and accepts NO reservations -- general inquiries only. Emailing it and waiting is not a booking. A RESERVATION OBTAINED FROM ANYONE BUT EBRPD IS VOID: reservations are for personal use only, and any resale, transfer, for-profit use or membership arrangement not approved in advance by a Special Event permit is cancelled immediately, without notice, refund or reimbursement. EBRPD states there are currently NO approved third-party vendors, so every third-party booking is void. Public advertising of a reservation, including on social media, Meetup or Eventbrite, needs a special event permit on file.
change_cancel: Changes and cancellations are NOT accepted by email, even though reservations@ebparks.org is published -- the same address that accepts no bookings accepts no cancellations. Call (888) 327-2757 option 2, or 510-544-2707 from Canada, Mon-Fri 9am-4pm Pacific.
release_mechanics: On a reservation opening date: phone only from 9am, no walk-ins, phones closed 12-1pm, and a maximum of two reservations per call. A party needing three sites needs a second call, at the moment the line is busiest.

method: Online at reserveamerica.com (search the park name), or by phone through EBRPD Reservations. EXCEPT ADA CAMPSITES, WHICH ARE PHONE ONLY -- an accessible site cannot be booked through the same online checkout that sells every other family site, so a camper who needs one must call during office hours and cannot secure it at the moment inventory opens online.
lead_time: Online booking opens 12 weeks ahead and closes 48 hours before arrival. EBRPD's reservations page states the minimum as 2 business days rather than 48 hours; over a weekend those differ, and which applies may follow the channel -- 48 hours online, 2 business days by phone -- but that reading is not stated by either source.
change_cancel: A family campsite reservation CAN be cancelled online, but CANNOT be changed online -- any change means calling Reservations during office hours. Booking a different date is therefore not self-service.
release_mechanics: Family campsites are released on a rolling 12-week window, so a date becomes bookable 12 weeks out.

method: Phone only, through EBRPD Reservations. Backpack campsites are NOT bookable online -- reserveamerica.com does not sell them.
lead_time: At least 48 hours before arrival, by phone.
change_cancel: Changes and cancellations by phone only. Not cancellable online.

method: Phone only, through EBRPD Reservations. Group campsites are NOT bookable online. Availability can be viewed on ReserveAmerica, but the booking itself is by phone.
lead_time: At least 3 days before arrival, by phone. EBRPD's own pages say '3 business days' and the booking system says '3 days'; over a weekend those differ.
change_cancel: Changes and cancellations by phone only. Not cancellable online. Equestrian reservations are handled the same way.
